Question 14

The length of a curve y=f(x) is given by ∫011+1(2−x)2dx. Which of the following could be an equation for this curve?

a
y=ln⁡(4+x)+1
b
y=ln⁡(2−x)+1
c
y=ln⁡(1−x)+1
d
y=ln⁡(x)+1
e
y=ln⁡(2x)+1
